data.name: Arron
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Arron means 'little lion'. This strong and courageous name is derived from the Greek word 'arrhos', meaning 'manly' or 'courageous'. In the Bible, there is no character named Arron, but the name has a spiritual connection to the lion of Judah and the courageousness of Christ.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the strength and courage of God.

in_greek.name: Αρρών
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name אהרון (Aharon), meaning 'mountain of strength' or 'exalted mountain'. In Greek mythology, Arron was an epithet of the god Helios, representing the golden mountain of the sun.

Even though there is no character named Arron in the Bible, the name carries a deep spiritual meaning. The lion is a powerful symbol in scripture, representing Christ in several passages. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.'"
